in_marathi.name: Suvarna
in_marathi.long_meaning: Suvarna हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Suvarna is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘Suvarna’ which means ‘Golden’. It is a name that signifies prosperity, wealth, and abundance. The name is believed to bring good fortune and success in all endeavors.
